# David Madali

> Prague-based analyst of the defence industry, critical raw materials and the space economy. Founder of Bohemia Defense (2024) and creator of OreOrbit, a free, live atlas of the twelve critical minerals behind Europe's defence and space industries. Quoted by BBC News Chinese as an analyst. Works in Czech and English.

## Profile
- [About David Madali](https://madali.cz/): background, projects, media, speaker topics and contact (Czech: https://madali.cz/cs/)
- [Founder page on Bohemia Defense](https://bohemiadefense.com/david-madali/): background, projects and media (Czech: https://bohemiadefense.com/david-madali-cz/)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidmadali/): analysis posts that reach up to 450,000 views
- [Press photo](https://madali.cz/david-madali-press.jpg): 1280 × 1600

## Background
- 2024: founded Bohemia Defense, an independent analysis project on Europe's defence industry, security and foreign policy
- 2025: Bc. in economics and management, University of Economics and Management, Prague
- 2025: quoted by BBC News Chinese as an analyst
- 2025–26: economic diplomacy at the Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs, office of the chief economist
- 2026: export consulting at CzechTrade; set up Chytrá bezpečnost, a cluster of security-industry companies
- 2026: EUSPA training in space technologies and building a space business; built OreOrbit

## Projects
- [Bohemia Defense](https://bohemiadefense.com/): case studies on NATO, Ukraine, Africa, the European defence industry and critical raw materials (Czech: https://bohemiadefense.com/cs/)
- [OreOrbit atlas](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/): mines, refineries, sea routes and chokepoints behind twelve minerals (rare earths, titanium, tungsten, antimony, magnesium, manganese, gallium, germanium, lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite); satellite pictures of 43 sites every week; ships, heat at the plants and disaster alerts every few hours; export-control deadlines and a quick check by product type
- [OreOrbit Dependency Index](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/dependency-index.html): a monthly figure for China's share of EU imports of the index minerals, from Eurostat data, free to quote with credit (Czech: https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/dependency-index-cs.html)
- [OreOrbit library](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/index.html): a citable page for every mineral and site, plus guides on China's export controls, Article 24 of the EU Critical Raw Materials Act and minerals for the space industry
- [Weekly briefs](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/briefs.html): every Monday, a dated summary of the week in critical minerals and Europe's defence supply chain
- [Services](https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/services.html): the free atlas and Monday brief, paid monitoring of the minerals a company depends on, and a readiness review of one product line (Czech: https://bohemiadefense.com/atlas/p/services-cs.html)

## Media
- [BBC News Chinese, July 2025](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cy8gjpe7xp8o/trad): quoted as an analyst on the security of the Taiwanese vice-president's visit to Prague

## Speaker topics
- Europe's defence runs on twelve minerals: where the dependency really sits
- Export controls as a weapon: what China's licensing means for European factories
- Watching supply chains from orbit: satellites, ships and open data
- Central Europe's defence-industry boom and its raw-material bottlenecks

## Topics
Defence industry, critical raw materials, rare earths, export controls, space economy, supply-chain risk, European security, economic diplomacy, Central European defence markets
